_doc: The Gate of Desert Beach, the rest stop after the Golden Mole. Same format as data/megalopolis/story.json. Ours: the lines. The original has Keeper Julio at this gate (NpcTalk_Beach, NPC 1045).

lines: You beat the Golden Mole? Then you've earned a sit-down. Mind the sand.
I keep a counter at every gate. Old habit. In the server days the queue for storage went all the way back to the bridge.
Your shelves came with me, every one. Swap what you're wearing for something you stored, or leave me a find before the desert eats it.
Desert Beach is past the bridge. Take what you need off the shelves.
